newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany praises Deng for opening, reforming China.
newsitem.headline: Germany praises Deng for opening, reforming China.

text.p: Germany on Thursday described China's Deng Xiaoping as an important statesman who had decisively influenced China's development over 20 years.
"Deng Xiaoping counts as one of the great leadership personalities of China's recent history," Chancellor Helmut Kohl said in a statement, offering his condolences to the Chinese people.

"The policies of opening up and reform, which have brought the country much economic success and allowed a significant improvement in the quality of life for the Chinese people, go significantly back to his deeds," President Roman Herzog said.
In their statements, both Herzog and Kohl praised Deng for opening China to relations with foreign countries, which had led to such "close and trusting" relations with Germany.
"I am sure that these relations will continue to develop positively and deepen," Herzog said.
